task: Meta-analysis of Glucose / BMI / BloodPressure vs Diabetes / Stroke / HeartDisease across 3 healthcare datasets

methods.effect_size: Cohen's d = (mean_cases - mean_controls)/pooled_sd (ddof=1 SDs); var_d = (n1+n0)/(n1*n0) + d^2/(2(n1+n0)); Hedges' g recorded as sensitivity only
methods.meta_analysis: Inverse-variance weighted fixed-effect IVW: meta = sum(w_i d_i)/sum(w_i), w_i=1/var_d_i; se = sqrt(1/sum w); z = meta/se; two-tailed p from standard normal (scipy norm.sf(|z|)*2). Single-study pairs collapse to d_1 with the same normal-based p-value.
methods.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR over all 8 associations, cumulative-minimum enforcement, capped at 1.0, applied to unrounded p-values
methods.ranking: score = |meta_effect_size| * (-log10(fdr_p + 1e-10)) computed on UNROUNDED values, sorted descending; rank 1 = most clinically significant
methods.confidence: high if fdr_p<0.01 and |d|>0.5; medium if fdr_p<0.05 and |d|>0.3; else low (unrounded values, strict inequalities)

data_cleaning.Healthcare-Diabetes.csv: Glucose/BloodPressure/BMI zero-codes replaced by NaN (18 / 125 / 39 rows); pairwise deletion per association; no imputation, no trimming
data_cleaning.healthcare-dataset-stroke-data.csv: bmi coerced to numeric (201 'N/A' -> NaN); implausible extremes (bmi>60, age<1) retained in primary analysis, excluded in sensitivity run
data_cleaning.heart_disease_uci.csv: trestbps coerced to numeric and 0 -> NaN (59 nulls + 1 zero = 60 missing); outcome HeartDisease = (num>0); 4 site sub-studies from 'dataset' column, all retained (Switzerland n_controls=8 kept but down-weighted, no site dropped)

medium: HeartDisease-BloodPressure (d=0.3034 IVW over 4 UCI sites, rank 6)
results_overview.reporting_note: meta_p_value / fdr_corrected_p are rounded to 6 dp as specified, so extremely small p-values (Glucose pairs, Diabetes-BP) display as 0.0 in the CSV; unrounded values are in meta_analysis_summary.json

not_feasible: Stroke-BloodPressure: stroke cohort only has binary hypertension, no continuous BP (binary substitute explicitly prohibited)
rejected_binary_substitutes: hypertension (binary) for BloodPressure in stroke cohort
fbs (binary) for Glucose in UCI heart dataset
